vendor: Matterport, LLC (subsidiary of CoStar Group, Inc.)
product_family: 3D digital twin platform for real estate, facilities management, design, and construction with AI-powered features. SaaS offerings: Free, Starter, Professional, Business, and Enterprise plans with integrations to Procore, Autodesk, and AWS IoT Twinmaker.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Undergo independent third-party, annual audits against SOC2's Trust Principles of Security, Availability and Confidentiality. Audited by Frank, Rimerman + Co. LLP (independent CPA firm). Announced November 22, 2021. SOC 3 report available without NDA.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27001 certification found on Matterport domain despite multiple searches of trust center and security documentation.

certifications.name: HIPAA / HIPAA BAA
certifications.proof_quote: No Business Associate Agreement or HIPAA compliance language found in Matterport's legal documents, terms of use, or trust center. No HIPAA BAA mentioned in Enterprise Addendum.

certifications.name: GDPR DPA
certifications.proof_quote: Data Processing Addendum and Standard Contractual Clauses available for GDPR compliance. DPA references GDPR, CCPA, UK GDPR, and PIPEDA requirements.

certifications.name: CCPA DPA
certifications.proof_quote: Data Processing Addendum explicitly addresses California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) compliance with DPA available.

certifications.name: UK GDPR DPA
certifications.proof_quote: Data Processing Addendum explicitly covers UK Data Protection Act (2018) and UK GDPR requirements.

certifications.name: PIPEDA DPA
certifications.proof_quote: Data Processing Addendum includes Canadian Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA) compliance.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No PCI DSS certification found for Matterport. Parent company CoStar Group complies with PCI DSS Level 2, but this is CoStar's certification, not Matterport's.

certifications.name: ISO 27017 / ISO 27018
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27017 (cloud-specific) or ISO 27018 (personal data in cloud) certifications found.

certifications.name: ISO 27701
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27701 (privacy management) certification found.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Governance)
certifications.proof_quote: No evidence of ISO/IEC 42001 or other AI governance certifications found despite Matterport's use of AI features and customer data training.

privacy.ai_training_note: Matterport trains AI models on aggregated and anonymized spatial and environmental data to improve services and develop new features. No explicit opt-out mechanism documented. Matterport grants itself 'unrestricted, irrevocable, perpetual, transferable, sublicensable, worldwide, royalty-free license' to use customer content submitted to platform. Customers are prohibited from training commercial AI/ML models on Matterport data.
privacy.data_region: Infrastructure hosted on AWS (multi-tenant). Sub-processors located in United States and Australia. Exact data residency options not specified in available documentation.

security.name: Authentication
security.value: Unique user IDs, password controls with expiration, SSO via SAML 2.0 with multiple identity providers

security.name: Access Control
security.value: Role-based access control (RBAC), least-privilege access, prompt revocation on employment termination

security.name: Network Security
security.value: Firewalls, VPN remote access, network segmentation, continuous monitoring for unauthorized activity

security.name: Audit Logging
security.value: Audit logging for user access and system activity. Data breaches notified within 48 hours to data controllers (72 hours in Enterprise Addendum).

security.name: Penetration Testing
security.value: Annual penetration testing by third-party firms. Reports available upon request.

security.name: Incident Response
security.value: Documented incident response program with 72-hour notification window for suspected security incidents affecting customer data

security.name: Business Continuity
security.value: Business continuity and disaster recovery procedures in place. Backup data retention: 7 days.

security.name: Vendor Management
security.value: Sub-processor vendor management program with DPA requirements

security.name: Infrastructure Provider
security.value: AWS multi-tenant environment (physical security, facility access, environmental monitoring delegated to AWS)

products.name: Free Plan
products.data_scope: 1 Active Space, 2 users, basic features, no advanced integrations
products.notes: Entry-level offering for individuals or small exploration of platform capabilities

products.name: Starter Plan
products.data_scope: 5-20 Active Spaces, 3 users, essential features, limited integrations

products.name: Professional Plan
products.data_scope: 20-150 Active Spaces, 10 users, advanced functionality, collaboration features
products.notes: Most popular tier. Starting at €53/month (billed annually)

products.name: Business Plan
products.data_scope: 100-300 Active Spaces, 50 users, advanced collaboration and integrations

products.name: Enterprise Plan
products.data_scope: Unlimited spaces and users, custom configuration
products.notes: Custom pricing. Enterprise-grade security, advanced admin features, enhanced enterprise services. Enterprise Addendum available covering DPA, incident notification, security reporting.

products.name: Capture Services
products.notes: On-demand service: Matterport certified technicians scan spaces; customer uploads handled through platform

products.name: AI Features
products.data_scope: Generative AI for digital twin creation and enhancement
products.notes: Subject to Gen AI User Guidelines. Users cannot train ML models on outputs. Matterport trains on aggregated/anonymized data. Commercial use requires consent.

compare.pricing_model: Tiered SaaS: Free → Starter/Professional/Business (monthly/annual) → Enterprise (custom). Pricing based on Active Spaces and concurrent users.
compare.data_residency: AWS multi-tenant (US/Australia sub-processors noted, exact regions not specified). No on-premise or data residency guarantees documented.
top_certs: SOC 2 Type II (annual audits by Frank, Rimerman + Co. LLP)

flags: CoStar Group acquisition (completed Feb 28, 2025): Matterport is now a CoStar subsidiary. Privacy policy redirects to CoStar. Compliance may be inherited from or coordinated with parent company. Recent acquisition may affect data handling practices; verify with sales for current posture.

No HIPAA BAA: Despite some search results mentioning 'HIPAA BAA for healthcare facilities' in Matterport's context, no actual HIPAA Business Associate Agreement or HIPAA compliance language found in legal documents. Customers in healthcare should verify HIPAA readiness directly.
No ISO 27001: Unlike ISO 27001-certified competitors, Matterport only holds SOC 2 Type II. For procurement requiring ISO 27001, this is a gap.

Broad Data Licensing: Terms of Use grant Matterport 'unrestricted, irrevocable, perpetual, transferable, sublicensable, worldwide, royalty-free license' to user-submitted content. Customer owns copyright but grants extremely broad rights to Matterport.

AI Training on Customer Data: Matterport trains AI models on aggregated/anonymized customer spatial data. No explicit opt-out documented. Customers cannot train commercial models on Matterport data (asymmetrical). Verify AI training opt-outs with sales.
No AI Governance Certification: Despite AI features and customer data training, no ISO/IEC 42001 or CSA STAR AI certification found. Consider for AI-risk-sensitive deployments.
Governance: Matterport is incorporated in Delaware/California, disputes resolved in Santa Clara County courts. GDPR customers should note this US-based governance despite DPA availability.
